description: Source code for handling pack objects in Git, including object hashing, rehashing, pack list management, and pack data preparation.

methods.name: locate_object_entry_hash
methods.description: Locates the hash index of an object in the packing data, setting 'found' if the object exists.

methods.name: closest_pow2
methods.description: Calculates the closest power of two greater than or equal to the input value.

methods.name: rehash_objects
methods.description: Rehashes objects into a new hash table based on current object list.

methods.name: packlist_find
methods.description: Finds an object entry in the pack list by object ID.

methods.name: prepare_in_pack_by_idx
methods.description: Prepares in-pack index mapping for pack objects.

methods.name: oe_map_new_pack
methods.description: Maps a new pack into the packing data, handling race conditions.

methods.name: prepare_packing_data
methods.description: Initializes packing data structure with repository info and environment configurations.

methods.name: clear_packing_data
methods.description: Frees resources associated with packing data.

methods.name: packlist_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new object entry in the packing data.

methods.name: oe_set_delta_ext
methods.description: Sets up delta extension for an object entry, marking it as a non-pack output base.
